Tiger eye, revered for its golden shimmer and association with courage and willpower. Mookaite — also called egg yolk stone — a vibrant Australian jasper believed by Aboriginal peoples to carry the Earth Mother's energy, boosting confidence and dispelling negativity. Together they create a piece that isn't just jewelry; it's a small talisman for the free-spirited woman who wears her story boldly. Design Details That Matter The pendant hangs from a 43.3-inch (110cm) chain — long enough to drape elegantly over chunky knitwear. Wear it full-length over an oversized cashmere sweater or a flowy linen maxi dress for an effortless bohemian statement. It also doubles beautifully as a western boho accessory — pair it with a suede fringe jacket and wide-brim hat for festival season, or with a simple white tee and denim for everyday edge. This is the kind of vintage tribal necklace that works from autumn layers through spring transitions. Caring for Your Natural Stone Pendant Necklace Natural stones and stainless steel need gentle care to keep their beauty. Remove your necklace before swimming, showering, or working out — chlorine and salt can dull the finish and affect the stones over time. Keep perfumes, lotions, and hairspray away from the pendant; apply these products before putting on your jewelry. After each wear, gently wipe the pendant with a soft, dry cloth to remove skin oils. Store it in a fabric pouch away from direct sunlight and other jewelry to prevent scratches. With proper care, this bohemian horn pendant necklace will accompany you for years of adventures.
